assessmentSettings.busybeeScoringInstructions: BusyBee scoring: Award points only in 0.5-point increments, including whole points, from 0 to the question maximum. Select a rubric-supported allowed score; never report hundredths such as 2.85/3. Do not average or percentage-scale rubric criteria into an off-grid score. assessmentSettings.questionNumberingInstructions: Use each question's explicit feedbackLabel and questionNumber for student-facing feedback. These are one-based numbers in the full assessment. Internal answer identifiers such as A4 are not question numbers. Do not infer a number from an internal identifier or renumber a subset of questions. Match the response to questionId and its prompt; if they conflict, flag the mismatch rather than guess.

feedbackPolicy.instructions: For questions that lost points, use one short sentence per missed question, at most 25 words excluding its Question N label: name the specific error or missing evidence and one simple correction. Use everyday language; explain a needed physics term briefly. Do not repeat the prompt, rubric, score rules, correct responses, or internal IDs. If any graded question lost points, focus only on missed questions. If every question in the supplied grading scope earned full credit, give one brief topic-specific message using the supplied allCorrectMessage or feedback.whenCorrect; these use varied wording such as "Great work! You showed a solid understanding of [topics covered]." Use the assessment allCorrectMessage only when the whole assessment was graded; for a subset, name only the topics of the questions actually graded, combining at most three topics. Never invent a mistake or student evidence, or claim ungraded topics were mastered.
